arguments.name: dictionary_file_path
arguments.description: Path of a Khiops dictionary file.

arguments.name: dictionary_name
arguments.description: Name of the dictionary to be recoded.

arguments.name: data_table_path
arguments.description: Path of the data table file.

arguments.name: target_variable
arguments.description: Name of the target variable. If equal to "" it trains an unsupervised recoder.

arguments.name: analysis_report_file_path
arguments.description:
Path (absolute path recommended) to the analysis report file,
in the JSON format. An additional dictionary file with the same name and
extension `.model.kdic` is built, which contains the trained recoding model.
Note that a relative path will produce a report file in the current working
directory.

arguments.name: detect_format
arguments.description:
If `True` detects automatically whether the data table file has a header and
its field separator. It is set to `False` if `header_line` or
`field_separator` are set.

arguments.name: header_line
arguments.description:
If `True` it uses the first line of the data as column names. Sets
`detect_format` to `False` if set. Ignored if `detect_format`
is `True`.

arguments.name: field_separator
arguments.description:
A field separator character. "" has the same effect as "\\t". Sets
`detect_format` to `False` if set. Ignored if `detect_format`
is `True`.

arguments.name: sample_percentage
arguments.description: See `sampling_mode` option below.

arguments.name: sampling_mode
arguments.description:
If equal to "Include sample" it trains the recoder on `sample_percentage`
percent of the data. If equal to "Exclude sample" it trains the recoder on the
complement of the data selected with "Include sample". See also
[Database Sampling](../notes.md#core-api-sampling-mode).

arguments.name: selection_variable
arguments.description:
It trains with only the records such that the value of `selection_variable` is
equal to `selection_value`. Ignored if equal to "".

arguments.name: selection_value
arguments.description: See `selection_variable` option above. Ignored if equal to "".

arguments.name: additional_data_tables
arguments.description:
A list of tuples containing the data paths and file paths for a multi-table
dictionary file. For more details see
[Multi-Table Learning Primer](../multi_table_primer.md).

tuple_fields.name: data_path
tuple_fields.description: Data path of the data table.

tuple_fields.name: file_path
tuple_fields.description: Path of the data table file.

arguments.name: max_constructed_variables
arguments.description: Maximum number of variables to construct.

arguments.name: construction_rules
arguments.description:
Allowed rules for the automatic variable construction. If not set, Khiops
uses the multi-table construction rules listed in
[DEFAULT_CONSTRUCTION_RULES][].

arguments.name: max_text_features
arguments.description: Maximum number of text features to construct.

arguments.name: text_features
arguments.description:
Type of the text features. Can be either one of:
- "words": sequences of non-space characters
- "ngrams": sequences of bytes
- "tokens": user-defined.

arguments.name: max_trees
arguments.description:
Maximum number of decision trees to construct. The trees combine native
variables and automatically constructed variables, excluding features
derived from the text variables or from variable pairs. Decision trees
usually improve the recoder's performance at the cost of the
interpretability of the model.

arguments.name: max_pairs
arguments.description:
Maximum number of pair features to construct. These features exploit
bivariate partitions of native or automatically constructed variables,
excluding features derived from the text variables.

arguments.name: all_possible_pairs
arguments.description:
If `True` tries to create all possible pairs within the limit `max_pairs`.
Pairs specified with `specific_pairs` have top priority: they are constructed
first.

arguments.name: specific_pairs
arguments.description:
User-specified pairs as a list of 2-tuples of feature names. If a given tuple
contains only one non-empty feature name, then it generates all the pairs
containing it (within the maximum limit `max_pairs`). These pairs have top
priority: they are constructed first.

tuple_fields.name: first_name
tuple_fields.description: Name of the first variable in the pair

tuple_fields.name: second_name
tuple_fields.description: Name of the second variable in the pair

arguments.name: informative_variables_only
arguments.description: If `True` keeps only informative variables.

arguments.name: max_variables
arguments.description: Maximum number of variables to keep. If equal to 0 keeps all variables.

arguments.name: keep_initial_categorical_variables
arguments.description: If `True` keeps the initial categorical variables.

arguments.name: keep_initial_numerical_variables
arguments.description: If `True` keeps initial numerical variables.

arguments.name: categorical_recoding_method
arguments.description:
Type of recoding for categorical variables. Types available:
- "part Id" (default): An id for the interval/group
- "part label": A label for the interval/group
- "0-1 binarization": A 0's and 1's coding the interval/group id
- "conditional info": Conditional information of the interval/group
- "none": Keeps the variable as-is.

arguments.name: numerical_recoding_method
arguments.description:
Type of recoding recoding for numerical variables. Types available:
- "part Id" (default): An id for the interval/group
- "part label": A label for the interval/group
- "0-1 binarization": A 0's and 1's coding the interval/group id
- "conditional info": Conditional information of the interval/group
- "center-reduction": "(X - Mean(X)) / StdDev(X)"
- "0-1 normalization": "(X - Min(X)) / (Max(X) - Min(X))"
- "rank normalization": mean normalized rank (between 0 and 1) of the
instances
- "none": Keeps the variable as-is.

arguments.name: pairs_recoding_method
arguments.description:
Type of recoding for bivariate variables. Types available:
- "part Id" (default): An id for the interval/group
- "part label": A label for the interval/group
- "0-1 binarization": A 0's and 1's coding the interval/group id
- "conditional info": Conditional information of the interval/group
- "none": Keeps the variable as-is.

arguments.name: group_target_value
arguments.description:
Allows grouping of the target variable values in classification. It can
substantially increase the training time.

arguments.name: discretization_method
arguments.description:
Name of the discretization method in case of unsupervised analysis.
Its valid values are: "MODL", "EqualWidth", "EqualFrequency" or "none".
Ignored for supervised analysis.

arguments.name: grouping_method
arguments.description:
Name of the grouping method in case of unsupervised analysis.
Its valid values are: "MODL", "BasicGrouping" or "none".
Ignored for supervised analysis.

arguments.name: max_parts
arguments.description:
Maximum number of variable parts produced by preprocessing methods. If equal
to 0 it is automatically calculated.
Special default values for unsupervised analysis:
- If `discretization_method` is "EqualWidth" or "EqualFrequency": 10
- If `grouping_method` is "BasicGrouping": 10.

arguments.name: log_file_path
arguments.description:
Path of the log file for the Khiops process (command line option ``-e`` of the desktop app). If
equal to "" then it writes no log file.

arguments.name: output_scenario_path
arguments.description:
Path of the output Khiops scenario file (command line option ``-o`` of the desktop app).  If
the empty string is specified no output scenario file is generated.

arguments.name: task_file_path
arguments.description:
Path of the task file for the Khiops process (command line option ``-p`` of the desktop app). If
equal to "" then it writes no task file.

arguments.name: trace
arguments.description:
If True prints the command line executed of the process and does not delete any temporary files
created.

arguments.name: stdout_file_path
arguments.description:
*Advanced* Path to a file where the Khiops process writes its stdout stream. Normally Khiops
should not write to this stream but MPI, filesystems plugins or debug versions may do it. The
stream is captured with a UTF-8 encoding and replacing encoding errors. If equal to "" then it
writes no file.

arguments.name: stderr_file_path
arguments.description:
*Advanced* Path to a file where the Khiops process writes its stderr stream. Normally Khiops
should not write to this stream but MPI, filesystems plugins or debug versions may do it. The
stream is captured with a UTF-8 encoding and replacing encoding errors. If equal to "" then it
writes no file.

arguments.name: max_cores
arguments.description:
*Advanced* Maximum number of cores for Khiops executions. If not set, then Khiops uses all
available CPU cores in the system.

arguments.name: memory_limit_mb
arguments.description:
*Advanced* Maximum amount of memory (in MB) for Khiops executions. If not set, then Khiops
uses all available system memory.

arguments.name: temp_dir
arguments.description:
*Advanced* Temporary directory for Khiops executions. If set to "", then Khiops uses the
system's temporary directory.

arguments.name: scenario_prologue
arguments.description: *Advanced* Prologue to prepend to all Khiops execution scenarios.
